title: Saved image identity, fit, native original download and provider-disabled restart — light
proof: Exact IDs with duplicate names, 90x180 JPEG/240x120 PNG/180x90 WebP, keyboard/drag pan against pre-action values, Fit, genuine WebP byte download, persisted provider disabled after process restart.

title: Saved image identity, fit, native original download and provider-disabled restart — dark

title: Saved image sources and tuples refuse unsafe/oversized bytes before native assignment
proof: Eight unsafe/oversized input forms refuse assignment/decode; invalid/mismatched/duplicate tuples and Code session refuse; corrected structural WebP reaches genuine native decode and fails.

title: Saved image read failures offer one real pending Retry
proof: Session/history read validation refusals expose Retry; one held genuine read per click, accepted result renders.

title: Deletion fences held history and download validation, clearing visible pixels immediately
proof: Deletion invalidates held history and held download validation, clears pixels/metadata/thumbnail, revokes URL, suppresses download; reload remains unavailable.

title: Native decode and canceled preview callbacks cannot restore an older attachment owner
proof: Original native decode completes before hook holds completion; late/canceled-preview callbacks cannot restore prior/deleted owner; Back re-reads.

title: Opening a saved attachment preserves dirty, refused, reading and submitting Chat drafts
proof: Text/attachments, FileReader read, capability refusal and held send block Open; no-model setup reload happens before fresh draft; accepted clearing precedes reload; canceled Open restores editing.

title: Saved image metadata and controls remain reachable in all eight locales at minimum size
proof: Eight dark locales at 960x640 assert visible enabled controls, metadata and ancestor clipping bounds; eight screenshots per OS.

title: Saved attachment Open waits for the single pending Chat rename
proof: Accepted but held Rename PATCH prevents second editor, second PATCH and attachment Open; release admits correct target.

title: Same image owner preserves zoom and a held download across shell changes
proof: Same tuple retains Blob, zoom, disabled single download and exact GET counts through sidebar/focus/theme changes; one completed original-PNG download; deletion stays unavailable.

title: A 5000-character saved filename keeps the image and controls reachable in both themes
proof: 5000-character filename stem at 960x640, both themes: visible >=120x120 image region, full DOM filename, Home/End scroll, Tab to download, four controls trial-clickable, no root overflow.
